sections.title: Identity and form
sections.text: The catalogue's campestre entry is Acer campestre, field maple. It is native from Europe east to Iran and south to northern Algeria. This deciduous tree usually reaches 10–15 m. Its rounded leaves have shallow lobes, and its paired winged fruits are samaras.

sections.title: Image and uses
sections.text: The plate's shallow-lobed leaves, flower clusters and widely angled samaras fit field maple. No food use was verified for this profile.
